evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded CRUD-style behavior with specific inputs; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (URL invitation) and scope are clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped UI action with defined input; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A list/view of session items is a bounded feature; not overly broad.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single, clear interaction (select item) with obvious outcome; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Bounded add/create behavior; can be estimated without further detail.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard edit/update behavior with clear object (item); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard delete behavior; scope is narrow and clear.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Specific behavior change (reveal estimates before all submitted); bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Clear computation and action (accept average); implementation effort can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined condition and outcome; narrow scope.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple data entry for an estimate; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation within same session is a clear capability; can be planned and estimated.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified breadth: file formats, mapping rules, validation, error handling, and supported spreadsheet types are unclear, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: More bounded than full 'import': implies paste text into UI and parse; still reasonably estimatable at a high level.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games, so that I can find the previous game I'm looking for
evaluations.rationale: ‘Browse’ and ‘find’ are broad: could imply search, filtering, sorting, pagination, and access rules; scope is not bounded enough for reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: A transcript view is a reasonably bounded read-only feature (stories and estimates).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and object (game transcript); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Specific export format and object; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and scope (a game and its data); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped registration with specified fields; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard login behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Too broad: ‘account details’ could include many fields and flows (email change verification, password change, username rules), making estimation unreliable.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and data scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Specific display requirement; implementation approach is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Bounded password reset/reminder flow; estimatable at feature level.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {…} or {…}
evaluations.rationale: Clear configuration choice between two defined card sets; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Specific constraint (limit 15) on an existing capability; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Clear join flow with specified input; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Bounded display of current item; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A list view of session items is bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI feedback requirement; scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear reveal condition and behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined timing constraint for editing an estimate; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific data to display (prior estimates per estimator for current story); bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Clear display requirement for current round; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Specific timer duration and visibility; bounded feature.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and action for timer reset; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Bounded navigation/view of prior rounds within a session; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Specific consistency requirement for ordering; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition for allowing edits; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI element and placement intent; bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Coarse-grained and broad quality requirement across the whole site; compliance scope and target level are unclear, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Bounded deliverable (glossary/list); can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Too broad and open-ended (‘as fast as possible’) and unclear scope (which queries/tables), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Coarse-grained cross-browser compatibility for the entire application is broad and hard to estimate without scoping which features/pages and what ‘function correctly’ entails.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Broad, site-wide quality requirement with vague boundary (‘where possible’) and unspecified conformance level; difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Vague and unbounded performance requirement (no response-time targets or scope), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Broad and underspecified: could affect storage, UI, import/export, sorting, and validation across the system; hard to estimate without scoping impacted areas.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Subjective and system-wide (‘sensible/predictable’) without defining rules or scope; difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Vague (‘nice’) and potentially broad (‘when something goes wrong’ could cover many error types); not bounded enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Underspecified privacy/anonymization requirement (what data, what transformations, what threat model), making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Too vague and broad (‘some metrics’) with undefined metric set, granularity, and reporting UI; hard to estimate.
